---
description: "Use when creating or updating project documentation, development-unit plans, architecture decision records, or AI workflow guidance."
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"
---

# Scholar Artifact Builder Documentation Rules

- Write documentation in clear English.
- Keep one document focused on one concern.
- Distinguish decisions, assumptions, open questions, and acceptance criteria.
- Keep PoC decisions minimal and record deferred choices explicitly.
- Link to related plans and ADRs with relative Markdown links.
- Prefer short headings, examples, tables, and checkable exit criteria.
- Do not describe future features as implemented features.
- Update `docs/development-units/` when an implementation slice changes scope.
